basics.name: Kaustubh Ponkshe
basics.label: PhD Student in Computer Science, EPFL
basics.summary: PhD student at EPFL (MLO lab, advised by Prof. Martin Jaggi) and contributor to Apertus. I study how language models learn — pretraining and midtraining dynamics, memory and knowledge, and the efficient and reliable adaptation of foundation models.

education.area: Computer Science (Machine Learning & Optimization Lab, advised by Prof. Martin Jaggi)
highlights: Contributor to Apertus — the largest (70B) fully open and compliant LLM training run to date

education.area: Electrical Engineering (B.Tech) and Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning (M.Tech)
highlights: Graduated among the top 3 of the M.Tech (AI) cohort
Awarded the Undergraduate Research Award (URA 02) for one of the best bachelor's theses

work.name: Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence (MBZUAI)
work.summary: LLM efficiency, AI safety and security, post-training, and large-scale distributed learning, with Prof. Praneeth Vepakomma (CERT-Lab).
highlights: Made LLM fine-tuning more efficient, reducing parameter requirements by up to 90x without loss of performance
Designed update schemes for distributed adaptation, cutting communication overhead by up to 230x
Studied the impact of fine-tuning on safety and alignment, exposing limits of subspace-based defenses

work.name: Entrepreneurs First
work.summary: Selected for a curated cohort of founders building globally impactful companies.
highlights: Explored protein-language models to accelerate discovery of novel proteins for sustainable food synthesis

work.name: Adobe Research
work.summary: Structure-aware pre-training for scientific document understanding.
highlights: Built a structure-aware corpus of 100K arXiv documents and pre-trained a Longformer with global tokens
Achieved an 18% gain over sparse-local baselines on SciREX information extraction
